newsitem.title: USA: Auto-By-Tel to raise roughly $400 mln in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Auto-By-Tel to raise roughly $400 mln in IPO.

text.p: Auto-By-Tel Corp, which sells used cars over the Internet, expects to raise roughly $400 million in its initial public offering.

In a filing registered on Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the Irvine, California company said it plans an offering of four million shares to price in between $9.50 - $11 each. The company will sell 3.6 million shares in the offering and existing shareholders will sell 400,000.
The company has applied for the shares to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol "ABTL".
Montgomery Securities is the lead underwriter of the offering, due later this month.
